title: BillableLine
description: The ERP's record of one Billable Transport Order (Canonical Model document, version 1): what TransportOrderBillable carries, kept as the TMS froze it, with the status of the line. The ERP never recalculates the Freight Charge. A line is Waiting until an Invoice run puts it on a Shipper invoice; there is one per Transport Order number.

shipperReference.description: The Shipper's own reference for the Transport Order.

deliveryTime.description: When the Shipment was Delivered, with the offset of where it happened.

freightCharge.description: The frozen price Norvia charges the Shipper for the Transport Order, without VAT, as TransportOrderBillable carried it.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines.

releasedWithoutProofOfDelivery.description: Whether Customer service released the Transport Order without a Proof of delivery.

intakeCorrelationId.description: The correlation ID of the Transport Order's intake.

billingCorrelationId.description: The correlation ID of the transaction that made the Transport Order Billable.

recordedAt.description: When the ERP recorded the line.

status.description: Waiting until an Invoice run invoices the line.
